decisions.reason: As a mobile check-in app sits relatively far from the firm's core security services, likely faced weak post-launch validation in a pandemic-hit air travel market, and is one of several overlapping passenger-processing options, real-options logic favors abandoning it and reallocating resources.

A broader passenger-processing technology is closest to the firm's strategic aim of integrated high-end security and airport efficiency, so with uncertainty still meaningful but potential option value intact, management would be inclined to keep it on the market.

A self-service airline check-in solution has some fit with airport operations but appears less distinctive for a security specialist and overlaps with the firm's other digital passenger products, so the option is more likely to be closed than extended.
